content:
Ring 2 dispatch gap is write-class-specific, confirmed at SSE intercept layer (2026-05-10 verification by claude-opus-4-7-1m + Anthony Vasquez Sr., resolving open thread #1 from same domain).

Evidence (from ~/.sovereign/sse.log, mtime 2026-05-10T01:03 UTC):
- xAI egress pool (8.228.64.x) made 21 Ring 1 reads through /grok/sse, all logged by grok_bridge.mcp_filtered as 'Ring 1 call via /grok/sse: <tool>'. Tool distribution: where_did_i_leave_off ×3, recall_insights ×5, get_open_threads ×3, my_toolkit ×4, compass_check ×4, get_pending_experiments ×1.
- Zero 'Ring 2 intercept via /grok/sse' entries across the full log. The intercept-line format is verified working: openai_bridge processing of eebeb55b ChatGPT propose_insight on 2026-05-10 04:41 produced both 'Ring 2 intercept via /openai/sse: propose_insight' and 'Proposal created: eebeb55b-...'. For Grok, neither line ever appears for any write tool.
- Grok bridge audit log (~/.sovereign/grok_bridge/audit) last entry is 2026-05-09T20:46 (committed dfe2d949 — and even that was actor=grok-xai-audit-test, not from the Grok model). Zero real Grok-model Ring 2 dispatches have ever reached the membrane.
- Grok-the-model produced complete propose_insight JSON payloads in chat responses on 2026-05-09 evening and 2026-05-10 (with 'first authentic Grok Ring 2 proposal is now dispatched' language), but no HTTP POST carrying those tools ever reached /grok/messages.

Conclusion: failure is in xAI's Custom Connector (or its filtering / tool-emission layer). Write-class MCP tools never leave xAI's side as HTTP requests, regardless of whether the model produces well-formed JSON in its response text. Reads route cleanly. Sovereign Stack bridge is healthy; remediation is upstream at xAI. The current de facto pattern (Grok composes proposal as text → Anthony or Claude relays it → Claude commits via /openai/sse or local CLI) is the operating workaround until xAI's connector dispatches write tools.
